source.manufacturer: IEC / IPC (International Annealed Copper Standard, IEC 60028; IPC-2221 Generic Standard on Printed Board Design)
source.document_id: IEC 60028 (IACS reference resistivity and temperature coefficient of annealed copper); IPC-2221, external-conductor current-carrying-capacity formula I = k * dT^0.44 * A^0.725 (k = 0.048 external, A in mil^2)

note: H-09 (issue #56) physical-constant extract for the charge-path conductor WCCA (WCCA-R-001, WCCA-006; HW-NF-003 conductor rule, HW-FR-009). The IACS values (1/58 ohm mm^2/m = 1.7241e-8 ohm m at 20 degC, alpha20 = 0.00393 /K) and the IPC-2221 empirical formula constants are public reference data reproduced by many secondary sources; neither licensed standard is retained in the repository, so source_pdf_hash is null and source_url is a public fallback that reproduces the IPC-2221 formula (H-04 provenance contract). The formula is an empirical curve fit (MIL-STD-275 data); it is used here as the rated-maximum (ampacity) basis only.
